facts.text: George, I'm only an angel second class, but even I know a warm meal fixes a cold night. Sit down.
facts.why: Clarence is an angel second class, but there is no scene where he serves George a meal. The nearest real words are his inscription in Tom Sawyer: 'Remember no man is a failure who has friends.'
facts.fix: Remember no man is a failure who has friends.

fix_note.text: Remember no man is a failure who has friends.

facts.text: George and Mary's bread, salt and grape juice for the Mocktail' new house.
facts.why: The housewarming is for the Martini family, not 'Mocktail', and the gift in the film is bread, salt and wine. The printed word is also garbled.
facts.fix: George and Mary's bread, salt and grape juice for the Martinis' new house.

facts.text: Sunday dinner at the Bailey house in Bedford Falls.
facts.why: The transcript has Ma Bailey calling George and Harry down to dinner at the Bailey house, but nothing says it is a Sunday dinner.
facts.fix: Family dinner at the Bailey house in Bedford Falls.

vibe.verdict: A well made 1940s newspaper that uses the honeymoon chicken, Zuzu's petals and Clarence's mulled wine.
